plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.what: Least-code discipline (YAGNI, stdlib first); re-injects its rules every turn and into subagents

plugins.name: caveman
plugins.what: Terse output mode (~75% fewer output tokens); /caveman lite|full|ultra switches level
plugins.license: MIT (skills/, src/hooks/; engine dirs are BSL and not vendored)

plugins.name: jev-belay
plugins.what: Jev Stop gate: blocks a 'done' when files changed and no test/build passed since; code checks evidence first, Jev only judges the closing message
plugins.egress: api.typesafe.ai only when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set and a stop has unverified edits (4 questions: closing message + evidence counts, redacted)

plugins.name: jevmem
plugins.what: Jev project memory: Jev decides which turns are worth one line in JEVMEM.md and recalls them per prompt; inert until `jevmem enable`
plugins.egress: api.typesafe.ai after `jevmem enable`: prompt, previous two turns (shortened), up to 200 memory lines; secrets scrubbed by pattern (PGPASSWORD fix needs CLI >= 0.5.8)

plugins.name: building-with-typesafe-jev
plugins.what: Skill: Jev API (Choice/Score/Noul), confidence routing, anti-patterns, prior-art index
plugins.egress: none by itself; tells the agent to make a few live Jev calls when TYPESAFE_API_KEY is set

plugins.name: omp-utility-skills
plugins.what: Skills: omp-docs (answers from a fresh omp source checkout) and omp-config (inspect/change omp config)
plugins.egress: git clone of github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi when omp-docs refreshes its checkout

plugins.name: omp-delegate
plugins.what: Skill: hand a written brief to omp headless (`omp --mode json`), then review its diff before committing
plugins.egress: whatever model provider omp is configured with

not_vendored.name: Computer (computer-use@openai-bundled)
not_vendored.why: Codex's bundled plugin; the @-mention in claude.ai preferences does nothing in Claude Code. Cloud containers have no desktop to control.
not_vendored.instead: omp has built-in browser/computer tools; the Claude desktop app has the claude.ai computer-use skill
